items.text: Cleveland QB: Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol (DNP) and Shedeur Sanders is expected to start (schedule already lists Sanders). Also DNP - LB Quincy Williams (hamstring), OT Austin Barber (calf), DT Maliek Collins (elbow); limited - WR Denzel Boston, CB Myles Harden, C Elgton Jenkins, LB Carson Schwesinger, DE Jared Verse.

New Orleans: RB Alvin Kamara DNP (rest); limited - OT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle), RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion), CB Martin Emerson (shin), OT Asim Richards, WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring, returning from IR). S Justin Reid and G Cesar Ruiz full. Tyler Shough starts.
